title: GNK ASG S+Chat — public AI agent (streaming, knowledge-grounded)

aiGovernance.purpose: Public informational chat about GNK ASG, the GNK DINAMO group and the published portal content. Answers are grounded in the portal knowledge base (552 verified questions) and served through one of three tiers: OpenAI, Cloudflare Workers AI, or the knowledge base alone.

disclosure.text: Razgovarate s umjetnom inteligencijom. Odgovori su informativni i mogu biti netočni — provjerite poveznicu na izvor.

technicalControls.transport: Server-Sent Events (event: meta | delta | done | error)
technicalControls.rateLimit: Server-side KV limiter, 30 messages per IP per hour; degraded (no limit) if KV binding is missing

knowledgeGrounding.retrieval: scripts-local lexical retrieval with idf weighting; refuses questions outside the portal domain instead of guessing
knowledgeGrounding.allowedLinks: only pages present in the retrieved records

technicalControls.systemPrompt: Built server-side per request from the retrieved records. Client input cannot change it.
technicalControls.outputHandling: Model output is escaped on the client before any markup is applied; the user text is never inserted as HTML.
technicalControls.clientStorage: localStorage per browser: up to 30 conversations, titles and messages; server keeps no chat transcript
technicalControls.security: No tool access, no outbound mail, no file upload, no client-supplied system prompt, no personal data requested

risksAndRelease: Check GET /api/s-chat/health returns ok:true and the intended knowledge entry count
Perform an authorized safe test POST (no personal data) and verify event order meta → delta → done
Verify that an off-domain question returns matched:false with a contact route, not a fabricated answer
Confirm rate limiting and that no chat transcript is stored server-side
No independent substantive human review of individual answers is claimed; the editor is named for accountability only
notes: Internal product-risk documentation based on code inspection. Not legal approval, and not verification of Cloudflare/OpenAI data-retention settings.
